source.note: phoneDSH-only P27 contract vector; no dsh-bot upstream file exists. source.checkout records the pinned upstream batch this contract sits beside, not the origin of these cases.

delta: P27 B7a: Bot main-session id minting, Bot root, session/create header, runtime.started/runtime.exited, recovery/rebuild/erasure ordering, session/prompt and session/follow, phone/botClaimSession and the token registry lifecycle.
Every session case names the real request/response transcript it drives; expectations use `re:` for generated ids/tokens, `$created`, `$requested` and `$requestedPreset` placeholders.

Invalid cases freeze fail-closed behaviour: composed-preset mismatch, missing sessionId/agentPreset, non-conflict create errors, unacknowledged legacy claims, claim errors and a follow stream without its snapshot.
The session log file path is a host detail; the record list, not materialized/home/sessions/**, is contractual (see session-lifecycle.md section 7).
